thread:
maya (SRE): Heads-up — running a regional routing resilience rehearsal in us-east next Thu 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC. Goal: exercise cross-region routing + cache coldstart behavior, validate fallback policies, and rehearse manual reroute.
maya (SRE): No planned user-visible downtime, but expect short latency spikes and a small blip of 5xxs during routing flips. We may see KV cache miss rates jump for ~10-20m after cutover.
maya (SRE): Please do the following before the window:
- set maintenance flag in Console for your services
- suppress noisy alerts (see runbook link)
- suspend non-essential prewarm jobs
- leave at least one engineer on-call in channel
Runbook: https://redwood-internal.example/runbooks/resilience-rehearsal

jordan (infra): Ack. I'll set maintenance flag and freeze ASG autoscaling for the window. Will also pin some node pools to avoid churn.
rick (oncall): I'll watch the p99 and error budget dashboards. If we see >3% sustained 5xx for 5m I'll trigger manual reroute. Who's owning manual reroute steps?
maya (SRE): @rick (oncall) — SRE runbook has the manual reroute play (section 2). If play is needed, call out on this thread and escalate to eng-platform for routing override.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: resilience-rehearsal-us-east @ 2026-04-02T02:00Z (job id: rr-20260402-01)

katie (eng-platform): We'll pre-pin canary model variants to the smaller quantized builds to reduce cold-start impact. Question: should we suspend the global prewarm daemons or keep them for critical prefixes?
maya (SRE): Keep pre-warm for critical prefixes (auth, billing, session-init). Suspend background bulk pre-warms. Quick command to annotate the job to suspend:
```
kubectl annotate job prewarm-bulk maintenance=true --overwrite
```

nate (api): I'll enable verbose tracing for the window and add a short-lived sampling override so traces for routing decisions are captured.
zara (sre): I'll take 02:00-03:30 on-call for the drill. Reminder: opt-in to the rehearsal by 2026-03-30 so we have coverage.
maya (SRE): Post-mortem / findings sync scheduled 2026-04-02 10:00 UTC (30m). Please drop any test artifacts and spike graphs in the doc linked above.
maya (SRE): TL;DR: resilience rehearsal in us-east, expect ephemeral latency/5xx blips, suppress known noise, suspend bulk pre-warms, monitor p99+errors, manual reroute threshold = 3% 5xx sustained 5m. Ping me or @eng-platform if anything unexpected. :white_check_mark:
